name: dawa4u-mobile
description: Native Android / iPhone builds of the dawa4u customer and rider apps (Capacitor wraps the web apps in ../web).

scripts.customer:android: node build.mjs customer && cd customer && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.customer:ios: node build.mjs customer && cd customer && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.rider:android: node build.mjs rider && cd rider && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.rider:ios: node build.mjs rider && cd rider && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
